title: Measuring Counterfactual Credit in a Replayable Wildfire-Suppression Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.31499v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, learned critics are usually evaluated by how well they predict the team's return. Yet predicting a team's return and assigning credit to individual actions are distinct tasks. To test credit directly, we introduce FLARE (Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment), a stochastic wildfire suppression benchmark in which any moment of a fire can be replayed with different actions under the same random events. Replaying one step measures the immediate effect of each agent's suppression, which we call simulator credit and use for training. Replaying to the end of the episode measures the effect of each action, which we use for grading critics. translated_title: 在可回放的野火扑救基准中测量反事实信用
translated_abstract: 在协作式多智能体强化学习中，学习到的评论家通常根据其预测团队回报的能力来评估。然而，预测团队回报与为个体动作分配信用是两个不同的任务。为了直接测试信用分配，我们提出了FLARE（Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment，可回放环境中的火线学习智能体），这是一个随机野火扑救基准，其中火灾的任何时刻都可以在相同随机事件下以不同动作进行回放。回放一步可以测量每个智能体扑救动作的即时效果，我们称之为“模拟器信用”，并将其用于训练。回放到回合结束则可以测量每个动作的完整效果，我们用它来评价评论家的表现。在八个随机种子上与多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的比较中，模拟器信用将四分位均值燃烧分数（即每个格网的燃烧时间，经封顶并在地图上取平均，数值越低越好）从使用s…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出可回放的野火扑救基准FLARE，通过在同一随机事件下以不同动作反事实回放火灾的任意时刻，直接测量多智能体动作的信用分配，并以“模拟器信用”指导训练和评价评论家，相比传统MAPPO显著降低了燃烧分数。
en_tdlr: FLARE, a replayable wildfire-suppression benchmark, directly measures counterfactual credit by replaying any fire moment with different actions under identical random events, using "simulator credit" for training and critic grading to outperform standard MAPPO.
